verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a first-party CLI (pspace) in DigitalOcean's reference docs, with install and usage guidance for managing resources programmatically, including creating machines. A probe confirms the official CLI documentation exists. Evidence of its depth is thin: none of it describes command coverage, machine-readable output, or anything aimed at AI-native or agent workflows, and no community or hands-on account mentions using it. missing for 10: detail on command coverage and scriptable/structured output for AI-native workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install and use the new Paperspace Command Line Interface.
Programmatically manage resources using the Paperspace Command Line Interface.
You can create a Linux machine using the Paperspace console, Paperspace API, or Paperspace CLI.
